title: ISACA Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE)
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the ISACA CDPSE exam content outline (three domains and weights). Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: A privacy governance scenario requires an organization to establish and maintain effective privacy controls for processing personal data across business functions. Which action most effectively addresses privacy governance requirement 1?
options: Define clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability with documented policies and measurable objectives aligned to business goals
Rely on informal practices and verbal agreements to maintain flexibility in privacy decision making
Postpone formal governance until specific regulatory inquiries are received from authorities
Treat privacy obligations as optional considerations based on available project budgets
items.explanation: Privacy governance requires formalized accountability with documented policies and measurable objectives that align with organizational strategy and regulatory obligations.
items.reference: ISACA CDPSE Exam Content Outline - Privacy Governance

items.stem: In designing privacy-aware systems, an organization needs to implement technical and structural controls that embed privacy protections by design. Which architectural approach best addresses privacy architecture requirement 1?
options: Assume third-party components automatically satisfy all privacy architectural requirements without verification
Apply privacy by design principles by minimizing data collection, enforcing purpose limitation, and implementing appropriate technical safeguards
Collect all potentially useful personal data now and determine privacy controls at a later stage of system development
Prioritize system functionality over privacy controls and add protections only after deployment issues arise
items.explanation: Privacy architecture requires embedding privacy by design through data minimization, purpose limitation, and appropriate technical safeguards throughout the system lifecycle.
items.reference: ISACA CDPSE Exam Content Outline - Privacy Architecture

items.stem: Throughout the data lifecycle, an organization must manage personal data in a manner that respects privacy principles from collection through disposal. Which practice most appropriately addresses data lifecycle requirement 1?
options: Establish documented procedures for collection, use, retention, disclosure, and secure disposal with appropriate controls at each stage
Retain all personal data indefinitely to maximize future business value without defined retention criteria
Collect personal data without clear purpose and determine retention periods only when storage limits are reached
Dispose of personal data in an uncontrolled manner once immediate business needs are satisfied
items.explanation: Effective data lifecycle management requires defined controls for each stage including collection, processing, retention, disclosure, and secure destruction aligned with privacy principles.

options: Establish documented procedures for collection, use, retention, disclosure, and secure disposal with appropriate controls at each stage
Retain all personal data indefinitely to maximize future business value without defined retention criteria
Collect personal data without clear purpose and determine retention periods only when storage limits are reached
Dispose of personal data in an uncontrolled manner once immediate business needs are satisfied
items.explanation: Effective data lifecycle management requires defined controls for each stage including collection, processing, retention, disclosure, and secure destruction aligned with privacy principles.
